(1) **Full Page Sections (Top to Bottom):**
*   **Navigation Bar:** Logo (MTQΣ), Links (Home, Product, Ecosystem, Developers, Governance, Resources), Network Status (Monad), Connect Wallet button.
*   **Hero Section:** Tagline ("The Next Generation Monetary Protocol"), Main Headline ("A More Stable, Transparent & Inclusive Financial Future"), Subtext description, CTA buttons ("Get Started", "Watch Video").
*   **Feature Cards Row:** Four cards with icons and text (Stable Value, Low Fees, Cross-Chain, Community Driven). *Note: Two additional floating feature bubbles ("Real-World Asset Backing", "AI-Powered Economics") appear in the hero area around the globe.*
*   **Stats Row:** A horizontal bar containing four key metrics.
*   **Ecosystem Section:** Heading ("THE MTQΣ ECOSYSTEM"), Sub-headline ("Powerful Tools. Unified in One Platform."), Feature checklist, CTA button ("Explore the Ecosystem").
*   **Dashboard Preview:** A large UI mockup showing a user dashboard interface.
*   **Footer/Tagline:** Bottom text line ("Built for a more stable, transparent and inclusive financial future.").

(2) **Yes, there is a STATS ROW.** It is located immediately below the four main feature cards and above the "Powerful Tools" ecosystem section. The exact stats are:
*   **$2.4B+** (Total Value Locked)
*   **12** (Active Chains)
*   **250K+** (Community Members)
*   **99.9%** (Uptime)

(3) **There are mountains visible BEHIND the globe.** The terrain is not limited to the very bottom edge; dark mountain silhouettes are clearly visible in the background space between the bottom of the glowing globe and the dark sky/horizon line.

(4) **The globe surface treatment is a combination of solid luminous fill and point-cloud dots.** It features a glowing, translucent blue/purple fill that reveals the continental shapes, overlaid with a dense network of bright point-cloud dots (representing cities/nodes) and intersecting wireframe grid lines (latitude/longitude).
